title: reservation-migration-launch-kit-and-release-ops
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Co-ordinate cross-functional launch activities for the new Dedicated reservation migration flow and consolidated release notes. Deliver a launch kit for Sales, Support, and Solutions that covers reservation migration tooling, pricing/commit changes, API/console UI copy, and rollback criteria. Ensure release notes are reviewed and synchronized across SDKs, Console, Billing, and Marketing before GA.
acceptance_criteria: Reservation migration tool is available in Console beta and documented in the support KB
Release notes entries prepared for SDKs, Console, Billing, and Marketing and approved by legal and finance
Sales enablement deck and migration playbook published to Google Drive with runbook links
Billing system mappings validated in staging and an automated migration dry-run completed
Rollback thresholds and monitoring dashboards are defined and tested against synthetic traffic
tasks: Finalize migration UI copy and microcopy with Design (due 2025-02-20)
Lock API contract changes and tag SDK PRs for release (ENG owner: ENG-2871)
Coordinate pricing table updates with Finance and Legal
Create support KB article and internal runbook with triage steps
Assemble Sales enablement materials and schedule training sessions
Publish release notes draft and circulate for review (PM/Eng/Legal/Finance)
notes: 2025-02-13: Scoped feature set to migration-only (no auto-conversion) after privacy review; added explicit consent step in UI.
2025-02-18: Design reviewed copy; asked to reduce jargon around 'commit windows' for Sales collateral.

communications_plan: Internal: All-hands pre-launch briefing (1 week prior)
Sales: 45-minute enablement + Q&A workshop (3 days prior)
Support: 2-hour runbook walkthrough and test escalations (2 days prior)
External: Coordinated release notes + blog post on GA day
rollback_criteria: Error rate for reservation migration API > 5% sustained for 10 minutes
More than 3 significant customer-impacting mapping failures in production within 1 hour
Unrecoverable billing reconciliation errors observed in post-migration checks
post_launch_actions: 72-hour hypercare schedule for Support and ENG rotation
Collect migration telemetry and run weekly quality gates for first 4 weeks
Customer outreach to first 10 migrated accounts to gather qualitative feedback
Retrospective and launch learnings doc due 2025-04-01
